description: Credential-shaped values a person read and found MADE UP (test fixtures, examples in notes), so the MCP distribution build lets them leave. Named by the first 16 hex characters of the value's SHA-256, never by the value. A build that stops on a hit prints the hash: read the line, and add it here only when the value is not real.
